discovery_basis.why_relevant: The single most consequential live regulatory event for this cell. The Ministry of Finance published the draft ZDUPS on 17 July 2026 (government act ref 2026-1611-0063), public consultation closed 17 August 2026. It was prepared with Banka Slovenije to implement the new Article 74a of the Constitution guaranteeing the right to use cash. Substantively it would oblige credit institutions and Posta Slovenije to maintain a cash-point network with prescribed geographic coverage: an ATM within 5 km of the centre of settlements over 1,000 inhabitants, a branch near settlements over 3,000, a transitional target that by 31 December 2029 at least 90 percent of the population has cash access within 5 km by road, plus a free basic payment package including at least five free out-of-network ATM withdrawals per month. Draft texts and impact assessments in such consultations routinely contain otherwise unpublished coverage statistics and gap maps.
